content:
katie: Quick idea — add an opt-in "shadow v2" header so tenants can receive v2 responses for telemetry without affecting production traffic. low-risk way to get examples + quality signals.

ron: sounds useful. how do we prevent double-billing? telemetry vs billing needs to be clear.

samir: We can sample 0.5% by default and mark shadow tokens as "eval" so we don't charge. Need billing-side labels and a reconciliation job.

maya: Console needs to show a projected cost delta if they enable X% shadow. estimate = requests * avg_tokens * sample_rate. also show quality regression risk.

deploy-bot: feature-flag `shadow_v2_experiment` deployed to staging :rocket:

katie: header proto (proposal):
```
X-Redwood-Shadow: v2;rate=0.005;billing=off
```

ron: what about caching and KV differences? shadow responses may diverge and could pollute shared caches.

samir: :thinking_face: we should namespace cache keys with `shadow_v2` to avoid pollution and set TTLs aggressively for shadow entries.

maya: UX: add a toggle + slider in Console route settings, with an "impact estimator" button that runs a small preview job and shows expected tokens and latency distribution. link: https://console.internal/redwood/shadow-preview

billing: audit logs required. also need a flag so enterprise tenants can opt-out globally. we'll own the reconciliation tool.

katie: ok can someone sketch the telemetry events we want? need side-by-side diff metrics: quality (BLEU/ROUGE-ish), hallucination flags, latency, token delta.

samir: events (rough): `shadow.sampled`, `shadow.response_diff`, `shadow.kv_miss`. payload: request_id, tenant_id, model, seq_len, tokens_v1, tokens_v2, latency_ms, diff_score, error_code

maya: I'll prototype the console panel. can we hide sampling controls for tenants on reserved plans? legal might require explicit consent.

ron: security note — ensure shadow header can't be set by end users (only internal service-to-service tokens). :lock:

katie: agreed. doc this in the migration runbook and plan a 2-week canary for a small set of tenants. add a rollback button in console.

samir: tagging eng-runtime and eng-oncall to review autoscaling impact. :eyes:

katie: thanks — will open a short RFC and add a checklist: billing labels, cache namespacing, console UI, telemetry schema, security filter, canary plan.

maya: 👍 I'll start the mockups and post later today.

deploy-bot: canary gate created: shadow-v2-canary (5 tenants) — scheduled tomorrow 09:00 UTC

ron: great. quick follow-up — how do we communicate to customers? draft a small console tooltip + email for early adopters.

katie: I'll draft the copy. done for now, thanks all :heart:
